question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

__Unless __you carry a Covid-19 negative report, you can travel by air.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Provided**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is **grammatically incorrect.**
 
• Here, '**Provided**' should be used instead of '**Unless**'.
 
• It means 'only if; on condition that'. (यदि; इस शर्त पर कि, बशर्ते कि)
 
 
• *Example: She agreed to go and work abroad **provided** (that) her family could go with her.*
 
 
 
• Whereas, '**unless**' means 'if... not; except if'. (यदि... नहीं; तब तक नहीं जब तक)
 
 
• *Example: I was told that **unless** my work improved, I would lose the job.*

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Provided you carry a Covid- 19 negative report, you can travel by air.*
